analyzed_vuln.description: Heap OOB read in concat_hash_string due to missing bounds checks before multiple 4-byte length-field loads (e.g., first read at offset 22 and subsequent ntohl(*(u_int32_t*)&packet->payload[offset]) accesses). The function validates some payload segments only after reading len, so a truncated/malformed SSH KEXINIT packet can make offset reach/end past payload and trigger out-of-bounds reads. Crash is observed at ssh.c:99 during first length read.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In fuzz_ndpi_reader, attacker-controlled packet bytes reach ndpi_search_ssh_tcp(). When payload_packet_len > 5 and payload[5] == 20 (SSH key exchange init), code allocates hassh_buf and calls concat_hash_string() on raw payload. A crafted short/inconsistent KEXINIT structure (invalid/truncated name-list layout) causes concat_hash_string to read 32-bit lengths past packet->payload_packet_len, leading to ASan heap-buffer-overflow read.
